channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Cyclone Arnab: Andhra Pradesh evacuates 89,000 people as state prepares for landfall
item.description: Cyclone Arnab is expected to make landfall in Andhra Pradesh early Wednesday, with winds reaching 140 kmph. At least 89,000 people have been evacuated, train services cancelled and over 2,000 shelters set up. Odisha plans to evacuate 48,000 people.

item.title: Who is Jagriti Mishra? Animal activist whose shelter demolition row led to MCD official suspension, ₹5 lakh aid from CM
item.description: Jagriti Mishra, an animal rights activist, shared several videos on Instagram showing her confronting officials whom she accused of demolishing her under-construction animal shelter without prior notice.

item.title: Mumbai airport faces network outage, check-in shifts to manual mode; 327 flights delayed
item.description: A network outage at Mumbai Airport forced staff to switch to manual check-in procedures. While the airport operator said flight operations remained unaffected, Flightradar24 data showed 327 flights delayed by around 9.30 pm, with average departure delays of 50 minutes.&nbsp;

item.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro reportedly leaves for US after election defeat; questions remain over his whereabouts
item.description: A senior Brazilian Federal Police official reportedly said Bolsonaro had not exited the country through any regular migration point, leaving the circumstances surrounding his reported departure unclear.

item.title: Who is Poona A Bamba? Meet the retired Delhi High Court judge who trekked to Everest Base Camp at 64
item.description: Retired Delhi High Court judge Poona A Bamba trekked to Everest Base Camp at 64, completing a 10-day, 65-km journey with her husband. From corporate law and SEBI to the judiciary, she built a distinguished career, authored four books and championed mediation, human relationships and nature.

item.title: After 26 years at Microsoft, this techie is exploring life beyond corporate work through construction, plumbing & more
item.description: Former Microsoft director Shawn Mrzena accepted a voluntary exit offer in July 2026 after a 25-year career at the technology giant. Since leaving, he has explored construction, plumbing, product design and fly-fishing while taking time for family adventures before deciding on his next career move.

item.title: Israel elections 2026: Can Netanyahu lose polls but cling to power? How coalition arithmetic could decide Bibi's fate
item.description: Israel’s 2026 election could see Benjamin Netanyahu lose at the ballot box yet remain in power. With neither bloc assured of a majority, coalition negotiations, smaller parties and Palestinian-led factions could determine who governs.

item.title: Tamil Nadu: Why is Chennai making digital payments mandatory for liquor purchases above ₹1,000 from November 1?
item.description: The Tamil Nadu State Marketing Corporation (Tasmac), which currently operates 4,048 retail liquor shops, is pushing for greater transparency, stronger financial accountability, and operational efficiency.

item.title: GST rules on post-sale discounts, export refunds to change from 1 November
item.description: Businesses can issue credit notes for eligible post-sale discounts without a prior agreement, while CBIC clarifications address export refunds, registration timelines and tax disputes.

item.title: 'Dhurandhar' Ranveer Singh’s SuperYou brings its signature mass-market protein wafers, functional snacks to THIS country
item.description: Ranveer Singh and Nikunj Biyani's SuperYou has entered the US market with its fermented yeast protein powder in chocolate and vanilla flavours, now available on Walmart.com. The launch builds on the brand's growing presence in international markets.

item.title: ‘Perfect’ answer from AI? Ex-Yahoo CEO Marissa Mayer faces flak after asking chatbot to describe daughter's traits
item.description: The 51-year-old said the chatbot described her daughter as ‘empathetic, creative, and an animal lover’ — a response she called ‘perfect.’

item.title: Tamil Nadu’s TASMAC makes digital payments mandatory for liquor purchases – Implementation date | Cash to be stopped?
item.description: The state-owned liquor retailer's 4,048 liquor outlets in Tamil Nadu will accept UPI, debit and credit cards for purchases exceeding the threshold; employees face disciplinary action for violations.

item.title: A black triangular UFO hovered silently before speeding away: What US agents witnessed in latest mysterious encounter
item.description: The incident reportedly occurred in June near an unspecified national security site in the western US.

item.title: Weverse Con Festival India pre-sale sells out in minutes as fans react to ticket availability and booking process
item.description: Weverse Con Festival India's Mastercard Collection pre-sale sparked a frenzy, with tickets reportedly selling out within minutes. Fans questioned booking limits, raised concerns about scalpers and compared the rush to the expected demand for future BTS concerts.

item.title: Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia faces ₹50 crore Adani defamation suit over Modi documentary: What is the case?
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has ordered YouTube, X and Instagram to remove a 36-minute documentary by Hotmail co-founder Sabeer Bhatia concerning PM Narendra Modi and Gautam Adani. The interim order will remain in force until January 31, 2027, or until further orders.

item.title: Rare 888.88-carat natural black diamond ‘Infinity’ unveiled in Dubai; here's its decades-long journey
item.description: The diamond was discovered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and initially weighed 1,138 carats in its rough form. Andrew Coxon acquired the stone on behalf of De Beers in 1975.

item.title: India sounds alert over counterfeit Defitelio
item.description: The CDSCO alerts drug inspectors after the WHO warns that a counterfeit batch of Defitelio (defibrotide) is circulating in domestic supply chains.

item.title: ‘Don’t treat people’s lives as commerce’: SC pulls up Centre and hospitals over medicine mark-ups
item.description: The court reserved its order in a PIL seeking drug pricing reforms, criticising the Centre and NPPA for delayed action while questioning massive gaps between procurement costs and MRPs.

item.title: Minister Gadkari warns of penalties for poor highway quality as AI monitoring expands
item.description: Network Surveillance Vehicles will track potholes across highways, with contractors, consultants and officials facing blacklisting and penalties for quality lapses, the road transport minister says.

item.title: Higher support prices, strong edible oil demand to drive mustard area expansion
item.description: Higher MSPs, firm edible-oil demand and expanded use of improved seed varieties are expected to push mustard acreage to a record 9.5 million hectares in 2026-27. Even with unchanged yields, higher sowing could lift production, helping India reduce its heavy dependence on edible-oil imports.

item.title: Aadhaar update 2026: Can you change your mobile number or email ID via DigiLocker? Here's the answer
item.description: DigiLocker allows Aadhaar holders to access their digital documents, but updating personal details such as a registered mobile number or email address requires a separate process through UIDAI. Here's what Aadhaar holders need to know.

item.title: Chak De! India star Vidya Malavade’s witty response to fake electricity calls highlights growing digital scam risks
item.description: Actress Vidya Malavade has shared a video of a caller threatening to disconnect her electricity despite her bill being paid. Her witty response highlights the need to remain cautious when strangers demand urgent action or ask users to download apps.

item.title: War: What is FORTRESS? Inside Pentagon's 90-day war plan as US military bases prepare to survive without outside support
item.description: The approach is intended to help the US expand its defence manufacturing capacity quickly rather than begin negotiating arrangements and adapting factories after a conflict has already started.

item.title: Nigeria gunmen attack kills 62, wounds 52 and displaces thousands in Taraba state
item.description: At least 62 people were killed and 52 injured in a bandit attack on Nigeria's Taraba state. Thousands were displaced as gunmen chased residents towards the Benue River, where some drowned while trying to escape.

item.title: MoRTH notifies FASTag-based annual local pass
item.description: Priced at ₹1,500 or ₹3,000, depending on the toll plaza’s location, the pass offers eligible residents within a 20 km radius unlimited crossings at a designated plaza for a year, as barrier-less tolling makes formal passes more important.

item.title: Is Saudi Arabia buying peace? Report says Riyadh offers $1 billion to Houthis to seal Iran-brokered deal
item.description: Saudi Arabia has reportedly offered $1 billion to Yemen’s Houthis under an Iran-brokered proposal to halt attacks on the kingdom. The reported deal could fund public-sector salaries and reconstruction in Houthi-controlled areas.

item.title: Mint Explainer: Who qualifies for the Centre’s Diwali bonus, and how much will they get?
item.description: The 30-day productivity-linked bonus offers a maximum payout of ₹6,908 for eligible employees.

item.title: Lula’s comeback in Brazil election: 4 factors that helped him beat Flavio Bolsonaro and secure a fourth term
item.description: Ahead of the runoff, Lula changed his digital outreach, sought support from young influencer politicians and encouraged supporters to take their campaign both online and onto the streets.

item.title: UP clears 69.52-acre AI, robotics park in Greater Noida; 1 lakh jobs, ₹2,000 cr annual economic contribution expected
item.description: The park will house shared infrastructure and specialised facilities, including robotics testing and certification centres, rapid prototyping facilities, AI computing infrastructure, motion-capture systems and data laboratories.

item.title: Instagram tests 90-minute videos as it looks to challenge YouTube and retain creators: What is 'Features'?
item.description: Instagram is testing horizontal videos of up to 90 minutes under a new format called Features. The move aims to attract podcasters, comedians, and other creators. This will allow users to watch longer content without leaving the platform for YouTube.

item.title: Maharashtra drought: CM Fadnavis announces ₹7,500 crore relief package; how much will each farmer get?
item.description: Maharashtra CM Fadnavis announced ₹7,500 crore in advance drought relief for 1.5 crore farmers, with each eligible beneficiary set to receive ₹5,000. He has directed banks not to deduct any amount from the relief payments.&nbsp;

item.title: 'Why not use our very own Indian app?': Anand Mahindra reveals why he switched to BHIM UPI after meeting NPCI chief
item.description: Mahindra Group Chairman Anand Mahindra said a conversation with NPCI MD and CEO Dilip Asbe helped him understand the role of India's UPI infrastructure and prompted him to switch to BHIM, the payments app developed by NPCI.

item.title: Supreme Court seeks Centre’s response to publishers’ plea against data law
item.description: The challenge comes as the government implements the privacy law, which regulates the processing of digital personal data and imposes compliance requirements on organisations handling such information, including technology platforms such as Meta and Google.

item.title: US green card alert: White House clears key stage for PERM overhaul, but details remain under wraps
item.description: The proposal is moving forward amid a broader enforcement crackdown on the PERM programme by the US administration, as part of actions taken by the Anti-Fraud Taskforce led by Vice President JD Vance.

item.title: Anand Mahindra wowed by Visakhapatnam beach’s ‘raw beauty’, points to an ‘interesting irony’
item.description: Anand Mahindra says it does not look like a “conventional” beach and even shares an 'interesting irony'. Here's what he said.
